_readme: S720 lever (the gap census's reader_page_assignment lever, run 45319725062): Santiago Canyon College's 6 programs whose extraction placed none of the state's listed courses were handed a sibling award's section or the course descriptions (11909 18117 18118 21673 37073 42990). This plan prints every page of the college's 2026-27 catalog PDF, the file the capture reads (374 pages, 9489873 bytes at capture 43693830334), line for line, so a session downloads the whole log (gh run view --log), finds each program's own section and names its pdf_pages pin, or files it as a named gap. One load, no model call, nothing written.

questions.own_page: Where each program's own section opens (its heading and the first line of its requirement list) and where its list ends (its total), so a pdf_pages pin can name the page, the words it opens on and the page it runs through.
